## Left open by the earlier read (RD-044)

An independent reader judged the previous rewrite of this lesson. Fix everything below as well. Each item is as serious as an item under "Fix these".

### Findings

1. Rule L19 (Major if a step is skipped, otherwise Minor). Problem: Minor: the key calendar computations in examples #1 and #2 remain inline. L19 requires key computations in display equations. All solution steps are numbered and no reasoning step is skipped.
   > June $2$ through June $30$ gives $29$ days. July $1$ is day $30$.
2. Rule L25 (Major). Problem: Honorary capacity is necessary to apply the filing and divestment exclusions, but this only repeats that it is a legal category. It never explains what honorary service means or how to recognize it. No prerequisite is supplied.
   > Honorary capacity is a service category named in the law. Do not decide that a role is honorary only because it is unpaid.
